passages.note: Enacted exception for pregnancies resulting from rape or incest, within the first ten weeks of postfertilization age.

passages.provision_quote: the abortion is necessary when reasonable medical judgment dictates that performing the abortion is necessary to prevent any serious health risk to the pregnant woman or to save the pregnant woman's life; or (ii) the fetus is diagnosed with a lethal fetal anomaly;
passages.note: Enacted exception where necessary to prevent serious health risk to, or save the life of, the pregnant woman (or for a lethal fetal anomaly), before viability/20 weeks.
Senate concurrence roll call on SB 1(ss); Koch voted Yea, 28-19, not near-unanimous.

rows.reasoning: Sen. Koch voted Yea on SB 1(ss) (2022 First Special Session), a single-subject abortion bill whose operative sections ban abortion except where 'the pregnancy is a result of rape or incest' or where it is 'necessary ... to prevent any serious health risk to the pregnant woman or to save the pregnant woman's life,' matching the rung 'ban abortion except in cases of rape, incest, or a serious risk to the mother's life.' The 28-19 vote occurred during his continuous State Senate term (2016-present).
